rule: On dev: maximize Evidence Hit@3, then Hit@1, then context evidence rate, then prefer alpha 0.5, then smaller alpha. Select agent context budget using dev grounded answer grades and latency. Never use test for tuning.
agent_validation: Dev review: baseline, hybrid 2400, hybrid 4800 all answer 15/15 correctly; choose 2400 for lower token use and fewer redundant citations. Raw retrieval selects alpha .5.
